chars.SAMI: SAMI: a young Moroccan man in his late 20s, short black hair, light beard, wearing a crisp white shirt with rolled sleeves and dark blue jeans, a bleeding cut above his eyebrow
chars.NADIA: NADIA: an elegant Moroccan woman about 30, long wavy dark brown hair, wearing an emerald green satin blouse, black trousers and gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim Casablanca bar at night with warm red lights, SAMI lies hurt on the floor after a fight, holding his bleeding eyebrow, while NADIA rushes toward him through the crowd with a shocked worried face; blurred people and overturned chairs in the background

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the dim bar: NADIA kneels beside SAMI on the floor and gently lifts his head, SAMI looks up at her stunned as if an angel appeared, soft warm light glowing behind her

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a corner of the bar, SAMI sits on a wooden chair with his head down while NADIA stands over him and carefully wipes the blood from his face with a white napkin, concerned expression

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca outside the bar, NADIA walks ahead holding car keys, SAMI follows behind holding his bloody eyebrow, a white car parked under a street lamp

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the open trunk of her white car at night, NADIA takes bandages from a small red first aid box and dresses the cut on SAMI's eyebrow, his white shirt stained with blood

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Beside the car under a street lamp, SAMI talks and gestures embarrassed, explaining he has nowhere to go, NADIA listens with crossed arms, thinking

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NADIA opens the passenger door of her white car and invites SAMI in with a confident small smile, SAMI hesitates, surprised and nervous, night street

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the car driving at night through Casablanca, NADIA drives calmly, a doctor's stethoscope and a hospital ID badge lie on the dashboard, SAMI in the passenger seat stares at the stethoscope, eyes wide with suspicion
